history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that all positions at the D-1 level and above to be established for a duration of more than one year are sufficiently reviewed and approved by the governing bodies.
history.administration_response: The Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reiterates that the scope of this recommendation is limited to secretariat positions. In line with the recommendation of para. 333 of A/78/5 (Vol. I) for the financial year 2022, this recommendation does not apply to non-Secretariat deputy humanitarian coordinator and regional humanitarian coordinator positions. This recommendation is therefore considered implemented for Secretariat positions and overtaken by events as regards deputy humanitarian coordinator and regional humanitarian coordinator positions.
history.board_assessment: Given that the auditors found in the 2023 final audit that there were still some positions at the D-1 level and above of more than one year that had not been submitted for approval by the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

Therefore, while the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs agrees with the content of the recommendation, it continues to advocate for the exclusion of these positions from the scope of this recommendation, given their specific governance structure.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that all positions at the D-1 level and above to be established for a duration of more than one year are sufficiently reviewed and approved by the governing bodies.
history.administration_response: The deputy humanitarian coordinator and regional humanitarian coordinator positions contracted through the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) for the 2024 financial year were either eliminated in December 2024 or expected to be eliminated by mid-2025. As previously mentioned, this is due to the temporary nature of these positions, which are tied directly to evolving operational needs. These positions are not part of the nomenclature of the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs. The recommendation should therefore be closed, given that it has been overtaken by events.
history.board_assessment: Given that the positions are temporary, the Board considers the recommendation to be overtaken by events.
